title: Ginger Congee with Spring Onion and Soft Egg
summary: A soothing Chinese rice congee simmered until silky with fresh ginger, then finished with spring onion and a soft-boiled egg. Light, warming, and ideal for a gentle breakfast.
steps: Rinse the rice under cold water until the water runs mostly clear.
Put the rice, ginger and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil, stirring once or twice so the rice does not stick.

Lower the heat to a very gentle simmer and cook for 35 to 40 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice breaks down and the congee looks thick and creamy. Add a little more water if it becomes too dense.
While the congee cooks, bring a small pan of water to a boil and soft-boil the eggs for 6 minutes, then cool them briefly in cold water and peel them.
Season the congee with salt, then ladle into bowls and stir in the sesame oil.
Top with the sliced spring onion and a halved soft egg before serving.
